title: bug: keystore ECDSA sign unguarded size_t→word32 cast
description: In wp11_backend_keystore.c:166 and :180, both wc_Sha256Update and wc_ecc_sign_hash receive (word32)inlen without a prior UINT32_MAX guard. If a caller supplies inlen>UINT32_MAX the cast silently truncates; ECDSA_SHA256 hashes fewer bytes than intended (wrong hash), plain ECDSA signs the truncated hash directly. Both are silent cryptographic failures. The soft backend (wp11_backend_soft.c:390) does this correctly. Fix: add guard before each cast.
